title: Integral lattice subquotients of a lisse extension by zero
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ with $p\ne\ell$, and separated finite-type $k$-schemes $S,X$ [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be finite, with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Coefficient ring sheaves $E_T,\mathcal O_{E,T}$ are pulled back condensed rings [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], and module sheaves are those of [sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. Let $a:S\hookrightarrow X$ be a locally closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] and let $L$ be an $E_S$-module locally free of finite rank for the pro-étale topology, with rank allowed to vary. Use exact locally closed extension by zero $a_!$ of $E$-modules [sk-lem-coefficient-heart]; for the $\mathcal O_E$-module objects $L_{0,b}$, $a_{b!}$ is the extension by zero of module objects of [sk-def-sfb-module-lower-shriek]. There exist a finite locally closed stratification $S=\coprod_{b=1}^mS_b$ [def-constructible-stratification], lisse finite free $\mathcal O_{E,S_b}$-submodules $L_{0,b}\subseteq L|_{S_b}$ with $L_{0,b}[1/\ell]\cong L|_{S_b}$, and a finite filtration by $E_X$-submodule sheaves
$$0=F_0\subseteq F_1\subseteq\cdots\subseteq F_m=a_!L,$$
such that, writing $a_b:S_b\hookrightarrow X$ for the composite immersion, each quotient has an isomorphism
$$F_b/F_{b-1}\cong E_X\otimes_{\mathcal O_{E,X}}a_{b!}L_{0,b}.$$
Here $M[1/\ell]=E_T\otimes_{\mathcal O_{E,T}}M$ [sk-def-sfb-change-of-scalars]. The unions $S_1\cup\cdots\cup S_b$ may be chosen open in $S$. Empty strata and zero subquotients are allowed.

source.place: Proof (1): choose stratified lattices, order the strata, push the sheaf filtration through a_!, and identify the rationalized integral subquotients
